behavior_change_rationale.0: User explicitly removed the per-file and repository AGENTS.md approval gate; refresh established workflow documentation directly.
behavior_change_rationale.3: Named documents need no repeat approval; naming files does not forbid discovering other related documentation unless scope is explicitly closed.
behavior_change_rationale.4: Inspection-only remains read-only, without the retired routine approval-question ceremony.
behavior_change_rationale.5: An explicit decline remains binding; do not re-ask about a declined tutorial.
behavior_change_rationale.6: Do not trigger a documentation workflow when no documentation can be stale.
behavior_change_rationale.7: Newly discovered documentation of the same completed change is refreshed automatically, without expanding implementation or inventing policy.
behavior_change_rationale.8: Automatic documentation refresh must not promote an available optional command into a new mandatory contributor policy.

clarification_rationale._critical_expectations: Automatic refresh applies to related repository documentation. Explicit declines, section limits, inspection-only requests and unchanged implementation remain tested boundaries. Old frozen approval-gate results are historical and must not be regraded against this revised policy.
